list.caption: Storage locations
list.emptyBody: Add the rooms, freezers and fields where material is kept. Units are placed in a location when they are registered or moved.
list.emptyBodyMember: An administrator adds the rooms, freezers and fields where material is kept. They will appear here.
list.noMatchBody: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see everything.

stats.atCapacityHint: Locations with a limit that is reached

occupancy.summary: {units, number} of {capacity, number} units ({ratio, number, percent})
occupancy.unlimited: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}, no limit set

form.createDescription: A room, freezer, field or other place where units are stored.
form.editDescription: Changes are recorded in the audit trail with the previous values.
form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name of at least 2 characters.
form.capacityHint: Optional. Leave empty when there is no limit. Registering or moving units beyond it is refused.
form.capacityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000, or leave it empty.

actions.retireBlocked: Retire ({units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} still stored)
actions.retireBody: No new units can be placed here once it is retired. Past records keep pointing at it. You can reactivate it later.
actions.reasonHint: Why is it being retired? At least 10 characters. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
actions.reactivateBody: Units can be placed in this location again.
